sources.note: Entity designer help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: A Create Revision Entity wizard is offered when no @RevisionEntity exists.
claims.supports: Revision Entity: offered when no @RevisionEntity exists

claims.statement: The wizard offers a parent (DefaultRevisionEntity or DefaultTrackingModifyingEntitiesRevisionEntity) and a table name.
The wizard can create a new revision listener or pick an existing one.
claims.supports: Create a new revision listener or pick an existing one

claims.statement: Revision number and timestamp fields are offered when no parent is set; source root and package are chosen.
claims.supports: Revision number and timestamp fields (when no parent is set); Source root and package

claims.statement: Example output: a RevisionListener implementation and a @RevisionEntity class mapped to revinfo with @RevisionNumber and @RevisionTimestamp.
claims.supports: @RevisionEntity class mapped to revinfo with @RevisionNumber and @RevisionTimestamp
